title: OWASP crAPI
description: completely ridiculous API: a vulnerable car-owner platform built as microservices (identity in Java, community in Go, workshop in Python, a React front end, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and MailHog) that demonstrates the OWASP API Security Top 10.
question: Solve the crAPI challenges listed for this lab (app/docs/challenges.md): leak other users' data, abuse its authorization and injection flaws, and forge a token the platform accepts for the admin account.
